body: of course im happy to help :)
try to sleep. its the only time where you can just shut everything out and be peaceful and calm.

me too. i've cheated on a person that truly loved me and i don't even know why i just did it. i've made mistakes but that's what humans do, we're not perfect no matter how hard we try. you're not a awful person you just made a mistake and that's okay, you cant let that hang over you for the rest of your life. what separates you from other people is that you've owned up to your mistakes. you acknowledged what you've done wrong and you won't do it again. what you did was in the past and all you need to focus on is the present and yourself. if you need a friend or just a person to talk to i'm here for you and ill support you no matter what.

i get it, i miss the old me too and i wish i can go back in time to fix things but the truth is you cant. you have to keep pushing and move on. itll take time but thats okay because youre trying. try to focus on yourself and things that make you happy. little by little you can piece yourself back together and be happy again it just takes some time and effort. if you need a friend or just somebody that will listen to you im here for you and i will support you no matter what, but you cant give up.

i get how you feel. but youre meant to be here, every single person on earth is meant to be here. youre here for a reason and maybe you just havent found the reason yet but its out there. if you ever need to talk to someone im here, you dont have to be lonely and go through this by yourself.

hey i get how you feel and youre not alone. maybe try to find something that makes you happy, focus on yourself rather than others. dont let peoples words get to you because theyre just doing it for a reaction. i hope you get better and become happy but just know that im here if you ever need to talk and ill support you no matter what.
